answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 9 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in crystal, verified in bridge, and spiral names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 317 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
